lines.speaker: Production Intent
lines.text: To document the legacy of the Goddess Squad, who fought for humanity

lines.speaker: Interview Subjects
lines.text: The Goddess Squad and related witnesses

lines.speaker: Current Status
lines.text: Filming complete. Editing and review will take place after relocating to the Ark.
(A small memo is attached at the bottom.)
The Goddess Squad is the Central Government's propaganda. They're still being used that way, after all. However, it also remains true that they are the hope of humanity.

The only way for me to thank them is by preserving their glorious feats exactly as they were through this documentary. By the time the Goddesses arrive in the Ark, I'm sure they'll be happy to see the finished film.
